admission: Parent explicitly authorized implementation with reviewer regular-file/short-write/copy-rehash contract
production_api: bounded_serialization.make_writer(comparison.write_scientific, comparison.canonical, comparison.EXPECTED, comparison.require, *, batch_bytes=1048576, batch_rows=1024, copy_bytes=1048576)

regular_file_failure_contract.short_write: Require exact full requested count; else OSError without retry
regular_file_failure_contract.declared_difference: Original single-write caller ignored return count; exact kernel failure-prefix length is not invariant under chunking
regular_file_failure_contract.original_exception: Actual IO errors propagate; secondary close/manifest errors do not mask primary
regular_file_failure_contract.failure_retention: Earlier completed finals, failing prefix/corrupt final and private stage remain; later finals not opened
regular_file_failure_contract.cleanup: Successful stage removed only after all copies close and compare; no deletion of old-run evidence

stage_integrity: Record fstat identity/mode/size/mtime/ctime at generation; compare path and opened descriptor before and after copy; rehash/count existing copy reads and compare after close; final regular-file size checked

full_io_and_hash_bill.notes: Retains v1 complete bill; adds copy hash work, file metadata checks and bounded manifests. Independent parent artifact validation read costs remain separate. No fsync or crash-atomicity promise.

scope_limitations: Eager witness secondary lists retained in this first implementation
Literal fallback retains original unbounded allocations
No arbitrary file-like or concurrent-mutating caller equivalence claim
Parent owns actual source/runtime binary custody and combined guard sealing
No measured wall/CPU/RSS result; all scientific comparisons/tests remain parent-only
